h: Tyson Fury opens up on mental health crisis in Netflix documentary
p: Former heavyweight champion Tyson Fury spoke about a severe mental health crisis in a Netflix documentary. A claim that he had been diagnosed with schizophrenia was later removed after it emerged he has not been medically diagnosed with the condition.
body: Former world heavyweight boxing champion Tyson Fury has reportedly spoken about a severe mental health crisis.

The 38-year-old British boxer opens up about his struggles in an upcoming Netflix documentary titled Fury, which looks at his life, career and personal battles. It features interviews with Fury, his wife Paris and his father John.

Fury and his wife recalled how, after he was hospitalised with a suspected heart attack in June 2016, he began hearing threatening voices. At the time he had sunk into depression and was struggling with drugs and alcohol. He described that period as an indescribable darkness and said he feared he would end up locked away.
Fury has previously spoken publicly about his battle with bipolar disorder.

Netflix has since removed references to schizophrenia from the documentary after it emerged that Fury has not been medically diagnosed with the condition. The claim had come from remarks by his wife, Paris. An earlier version of this story said he had been diagnosed with schizophrenia; that was not correct.
more: Fury speaks about his mental health crisis in a Netflix documentary.
The crisis began after a 2016 hospital stay.
A schizophrenia claim was later removed from the film.
